decision_basis: After measured seed0 macro improvement and task-level regressions; fixed replication only, not blind method preregistration.
sampling_rule: Same seed pair records identical initial model / torch CPU RNG / sampler hashes and actual ordered index chain. Stream audit default off for historical compatibility; checkpoint resume restores chain.
resume_rule: Explicit immutable launch script may resume a stopped run only from its own last checkpoint; completed runs validate config/artifact hashes then skip, never duplicate.
decision_rule: Complete these four runs, report all three paired seeds best and fixed1500 with task/parent deltas. No seed searching, added modules or hyperparameter tuning if gains fail replication.
limitations: Repeated 12-parent development set, reference-only metrics, no semantic/contact/collision/execution certification. Conventional auxiliary baseline repair, not paper core.
